bullet_edits.text: Sole owner of example platform migrations from on-premises servers to containerised Kubernetes environments on AWS, running discovery, target design, build, cutover and validation across development, testing and production.

Replaced manual recovery of failed releases on self-managed Kubernetes clusters with a GitLab CI pipeline that detects failure, retries and rolls back on its own, so environments recover without an engineer.

Met recovery targets by designing multi-zone topologies on AWS with EKS, provisioned with Terraform and configured with Ansible across EC2, VPC, IAM, S3, RDS, ELB and CloudWatch, proven through 4 scheduled failover tests a year.

Debugged the cluster through bring-up, working through pods stuck in CrashLoopBackOff and persistent volumes that failed to mount, on Kubernetes with Helm and Docker, until the whole workload ran end to end.

Held first-line responsibility on a rotating 24/7 on-call for a production web application on AWS with Prometheus, triaging incidents from alert to root cause with no major escalation during the support period.

Automated monthly patching and configuration drift checks for 30 Linux and Windows servers with Ansible playbooks run from a scheduled pipeline, cutting the maintenance window from a full day to two hours with Kubernetes and Helm.

focus.skills: Kubernetes on AWS and CI/CD first
focus.experience: migration and pipeline work in Kubernetes and AWS terms
